items.heading: Look for Verbs, Not Only
items.text: Look for verbs, not only titles. Job descriptions that mention implement, automate, evaluate, enable, govern, synthesize, or operationalize AI are often more useful than waiting for a clean AI title.

items.heading: Track Hybrid Phrases
items.text: Track hybrid phrases. Titles like operations manager, product specialist, enablement lead, analyst, or consultant may now hide real AI workflow ownership.

items.heading: Watch for Agent and Copilot
items.text: Watch for agent and copilot language. A role that asks for workflow redesign, AI tool adoption, knowledge-system setup, or prompt libraries is already moving in this direction.
